title: OpenAI launches GPT-5 with unprecedented reasoning capabilities
body: OpenAI has announced the release of GPT-5, its most advanced language model to date. The new model demonstrates significantly improved reasoning and problem-solving capabilities across scientific, mathematical, and coding tasks.

title: European Parliament votes on new AI regulation framework
body: The European Parliament has passed a comprehensive set of regulations governing the use of artificial intelligence across member states. The legislation includes strict requirements for high-risk AI systems.

title: Tesla reports record quarterly profits amid EV demand surge
body: Tesla Inc. reported record quarterly profits driven by strong demand for its electric vehicles in Europe and Asia. The company raised its annual production forecast.

title: Paris Saint-Germain wins Champions League final
body: Paris Saint-Germain claimed their first UEFA Champions League title, defeating Manchester City 2-1 in a thrilling final held in Lisbon.

title: Nouvelle découverte archéologique en Égypte remet en cause l'histoire ancienne
body: Des archéologues français ont mis au jour une cité antique près de Louxor qui pourrait modifier notre compréhension de la civilisation égyptienne. Les fouilles révèlent des structures datant de plus de 5 000 ans.

title: Breakthrough in quantum computing achieves 1000-qubit milestone
body: Researchers at IBM have achieved a significant milestone in quantum computing, successfully operating a 1000-qubit processor with error rates below 0.1%.

title: WHO declares new global health initiative for antibiotic resistance
body: The World Health Organization has launched an emergency initiative to combat the rising threat of antibiotic-resistant bacteria, allocating $2 billion to research and prevention programs.

title: Bitcoin surpasses $200,000 as institutional adoption accelerates
body: Bitcoin has crossed the $200,000 threshold for the first time as major financial institutions continue to increase their cryptocurrency holdings.

title: La France annonce un plan de 10 milliards pour la transition énergétique
body: Le gouvernement français a présenté un plan ambitieux de 10 milliards d'euros pour accélérer la transition vers les énergies renouvelables, incluant l'éolien offshore et le solaire.

title: SpaceX successfully lands first crewed mission on Mars
body: SpaceX's Starship vehicle has successfully landed the first crewed mission on Mars, marking a historic milestone in human space exploration.

title: Apple announces Vision Pro 2 with revolutionary neural interface
body: Apple unveiled the Vision Pro 2 at its annual developer conference, featuring a breakthrough neural interface that allows users to control the device through thought patterns.

title: Olympic Games Paris 2028 preparations on track
body: French authorities confirmed that preparations for the 2028 Olympic Games in Paris are progressing well, with new venues under construction and transport infrastructure upgrades underway.

title: Crise du logement en France : les villes moyennes en première ligne
body: La pénurie de logements abordables frappe désormais les villes moyennes françaises, avec des loyers en hausse de 15% en un an dans des agglomérations comme Bordeaux, Nantes et Lyon.

title: New cancer treatment shows 90% success rate in clinical trials
body: A revolutionary immunotherapy treatment developed by researchers at Johns Hopkins University has shown a 90% success rate in treating aggressive forms of pancreatic cancer.

title: Festival de Cannes 2026 : la sélection officielle dévoilée
body: Le Festival de Cannes a annoncé sa sélection officielle pour l'édition 2026, avec 22 films en compétition représentant 18 nationalités différentes.

title: Amazon expands drone delivery to 50 new cities worldwide
body: Amazon has announced the expansion of its Prime Air drone delivery service to 50 additional cities across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

title: Federal Reserve raises interest rates to combat persistent inflation
body: The Federal Reserve announced a quarter-point interest rate increase, its third consecutive hike this year, in response to persistent inflationary pressures in the US economy.

title: Lionel Messi announces retirement from professional football
body: Football legend Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from professional football at the age of 38, ending a career that saw him win 8 Ballon d'Or awards.

title: Climate summit in Geneva reaches landmark agreement on carbon emissions
body: World leaders gathered in Geneva have reached a landmark agreement to reduce global carbon emissions by 60% by 2040, with binding commitments from 195 nations.

title: Scientists discover new species of deep-sea organisms near hydrothermal vents
body: Marine biologists have discovered 47 new species of organisms living near hydrothermal vents in the Pacific Ocean, expanding our understanding of extremophile life.

title: Microsoft acquires leading cybersecurity firm for $15 billion
body: Microsoft has completed its acquisition of CyberShield Technologies for $15 billion, significantly expanding its enterprise security offerings.

title: Tour de France 2026 : parcours officiel avec trois étapes inédites
body: Les organisateurs du Tour de France ont dévoilé le parcours de l'édition 2026, incluant trois étapes inédites dans les Pyrénées-Orientales et une arrivée spectaculaire au sommet du Mont Ventoux.

title: Global mental health crisis prompts WHO emergency response
body: The World Health Organization has declared mental health a global emergency, announcing $5 billion in funding to expand access to mental health services in developing countries.

title: Réforme des retraites : nouvelles manifestations dans 60 villes françaises
body: Des centaines de milliers de manifestants ont défilé dans 60 villes françaises contre la nouvelle réforme des retraites proposée par le gouvernement.

title: Nobel Prize in Physics awarded for advances in fusion energy
body: The Nobel Prize in Physics has been awarded to three scientists whose work on controlled nuclear fusion paved the way for the first commercially viable fusion reactor.
